firstPart.title: Why is financial inclusion important in Latin America?
firstPart.main: El Salvador has a population of 6.3 million, and 77%, or 4.9 million, do not have access to a checking or savings account, and 5.5 million* lack access to credit. We are the best available option for financial inclusion and support.
firstPart.inner: The population of Texas is 31.1 million, with 12.5 million being Latino, and of those, 500 thousand are Salvadorans. 1.7 million* people do not have a checking or savings account.
firstPart.aditional: *Between both markets, we have 7.2 million potential customers.

secondPart.title: Positive Impact!
secondPart.main: More than 50% of our loans have been granted to individuals living outside the financial capitals of El Salvador and Texas.
secondPart.inner: Recently, we have seen an increase in clients opting for multiple loans, which means they are recurring clients who have paid off their previous loan and need a new one or additional capital.
secondPart.icon: This type of client and loan represents a much lower risk for us, as they have demonstrated excellent payment behavior and creditworthiness.
